page.overview:
Who is Anita B'ath?

Anita B'ath was a Human female who served as a member of the Ragtags on Corellia during the Galactic Civil War. After the Battle of Yavin, she lived in Coronet City and served as a henchman for Ames Miss'd, along with Box O'Rox. In 1 ABY, Anita B'ath and hes associates used to harass new recruits of the rival Meatlump gang. Angered by this situation, a food supply clerk of the Meatlumps tasked a spacer affiliated with the Meatlumps to teach the Ragtags a lesson. The spacer therefore met Ames Miss'd outside Coronet. The former attempted to intimidate the Ragtag but Miss'd was not scared and ordered Anita and Box to attack the spacer. Eventually, the spacer managed to kill them both. Unable to defend himself, Ames Miss'd surrendered and accepted to live the Meatlumps alone.

Anita B'ath appeared as a non-player character in the 2003 video game Star Wars Galaxies, a massively multiplayer online roleplaying game developed by Sony Online Entertainment and published by LucasArts, Anita B'ath was added to the game as part of the "Meatlumps Theme Park," introduced with "Chapter 10: The Search for the Meatlump King," released on June 19, 2008.
